title: [repo:objectui] Form field `immutable: true` is not enforced on the edit dialog — the lookup stays fully editable after create, while `readonly` disables required lookups on the create form; no flag delivers create-then-lock
body:
## Summary

A form field declared `immutable: true` (spec: editable on create, locked after the record exists) is honoured only on the create form. On the **edit** dialog of the same form view the field is still fully editable — the lookup's 「选择…」 picker is enabled (`disabled === false`), the chip can be cleared, and a new value can be picked. So the only tool an author has to say "this FK is set once and never changes" (`readonly` breaks create because required lookups become disabled) does nothing on the surface it exists for.

## Minimal reproduction

Platform 17.2.0 console.

Object `kpi_entry_line` with `sheet: Field.lookup('kpi_entry_sheet', { required: true })` and `plan_indicator: Field.lookup('kpi_plan_indicator', { required: true })`. Form view:

```ts
formViews: { form: { type: 'simple', data: obj('kpi_entry_line'), sections: [{ name: 'entry', fields: [
  { field: 'sheet', immutable: true }, { field: 'plan_indicator', immutable: true },
  { field: 'actual_value' }, { field: 'remark' }, ...
] }] } }
```

1. List → 「新建」: both lookups editable, record can be created — correct.
2. Open an existing record → row menu 「编辑」 (or record page edit): both lookups still render as editable lookups; picking another sheet and saving sends the new `sheet` value.

Control: `readonly: true` on the same fields locks them on edit but also disables them on the create form, where they are `required` — the create form then fails with 「所属填报单不能为空」. So neither flag gives "settable once".

## Expected

- `immutable: true` renders the field as read-only (display value, no picker, no clear ✕) whenever the form is bound to an existing record, and as a normal input on create.
- If the console cannot yet distinguish the two modes for a field, the spec should say so, or `readonly` should stop disabling `required` fields on create — one of the two flags must deliver the create-then-lock semantics.

## Environment

`@objectstack/console` 17.2.0 · `@objectstack/spec` 17.2.0 (`view.zod.ts` FormField `immutable`) · `objectstack dev` · Chromium 1440×900 · zh-CN. App: objectstack-ai/kpi (`kpi_entry_line` form).
